E0048

Teaching: positional tuples → named members (S73, D-SG7)

What

Teaching: positional tuples → named members (S73, D-SG7)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0048

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0048: tests/ui/positional_tuple.stderr.

Error [E0048]: Jet tuples name every member — positional `(1, 2)` isn't allowed (S73)
  --> tests/ui/positional_tuple.jet:2:14
    |
  2 |     point :: (1, 2)
    |              ^
 Why: named members make field access obvious and avoid `.0`, which collides with decimal numbers
 Fix: write named members: `(x: 1, y: 2)` and use `p.x`, not `p.0`
